tests.name: Edge-to-edge / safe areas
tests.assertion: API 36 portrait: NavBar below the status bar, tab bar buttons above the navigation bar and not covered, offline banner below the status bar, last footer link fully visible above the tab bar
tests.notes: window padded by Capacitor (CSS insets 0); status bar bottom 136px, navigation bar top 2337px, dpr 2.625; the edge-to-edge CSS path was also checked with simulated insets

tests.name: Offline
tests.assertion: Airplane mode + cold launch: app shell renders (not a browser error page), offline banner visible, no crash; /, /browse, /mausam, /msp, /about show content or an in-app failure state; back online the banner goes within 15 s and /mausam loads data
tests.notes: offline via cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable. What each page shows offline (input for batch 8B) — /: 4564 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 16, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0 || /browse: 1096 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0 || /mausam: 1131 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 1 || /msp: 2507 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 10, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 1 || /about: 2605 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0

tests.name: Keyboard + search
tests.assertion: On /search a real tap brings up a DRAWN on-screen keyboard (IME frame visible + screenshot differs), the focused input is fully visible above the keyboard and not covered, and a query known to have results renders results
tests.notes: query "wheat" → 16 results; keyboard top 1517px, input bottom 495px

tests.name: Keyboard never hides a field
tests.assertion: For /login, /signup, /search, the feedback form (/grievance), Profile edit and every /post step: the LOWEST text field, tapped with a real on-screen keyboard drawn, is fully visible above the keyboard (a), its submit/next button scrolls into view with the keyboard up (b), and after closing the keyboard nothing stays covered (c). Forms needing an account are NOT-RUN where no login is allowed (prod)
tests.notes: 4 forms measured; NOT-RUN here: /post (steps 2 and 3); /profile — need a logged-in account; the prod flavour is read-only (no account may be created or used)

tests.name: Home shows one "last updated" time offline
tests.assertion: Online visit fills the cache; airplane mode + cold launch: Home shows the offline banner with its time and NO second stamp under the ticker (exactly one timestamp). Online-but-saved-data (banner gone, data still from the phone): the stamp is shown

tests.name: /cold-storage failed load (app)
tests.assertion: Cache emptied, airplane mode, cold launch: /cold-storage shows the "could not load" notice with "try again" (no ErrorBoundary, no uncaught error, no spinner left); back online, "try again" loads the list
tests.notes: notice after 1811 ms; 28 cache entries cleared first

tests.name: Post page location fallback
tests.assertion: Logged in, /post step 3, "use my current location": GPS on → coordinates near the emulator position (which step: cached ≤ 10 min / fresh ≤ 20 s recorded); GPS off → within ~25 s the clear fallback message and the cursor in the village field, no crash
tests.notes: needs a logged-in account (Post is behind login); the prod flavour is read-only — no account may be created or used there. Run in the staging suite after S4.
